WITH replay AS ( SELECT app_id, SUM(replay_batches)::bigint AS batches, SUM(replays)::bigint AS logs, MAX(COALESCE(last_replay_at, day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) AS last_replay_at FROM public.ban_submission_replay_daily WHERE day >= #{since} GROUP BY app_id HAVING (#{checkBatches} AND SUM(replay_batches) > #{batchLimit}) OR (#{checkLogs} AND SUM(replays) > #{logLimit}) ), candidates AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT app.id, replay.batches, replay.logs, replay.last_replay_at FROM replay JOIN public.userapp app ON app.id = replay.app_id JOIN public."user" owner ON owner.id = app.owner WHERE app.delete_at IS NULL AND (app.banned_at IS NULL OR app.unban_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.ban_replay_application_suspensions previous WHERE previous.app_id = app.id AND previous.last_replay_at >= replay.last_replay_at ) ORDER BY app.id LIMIT #{limit}
FOR UPDATE OF app SKIP LOCKED FOR KEY SHARE OF owner SKIP LOCKED ), suspended AS ( UPDATE public.userapp app SET banned_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, banned_reason = #{reason}, unban_at = NULL FROM candidates candidate WHERE app.id = candidate.id RETURNING app.id, app.owner, app.banned_at, candidate.batches, candidate.logs, candidate.last_replay_at ), queued AS ( INSERT INTO public.ban_replay_application_suspensions ( app_id, owner_id, suspended_at, last_replay_at, replay_batches, replay_logs, batch_limit, log_limit ) SELECT id, owner, banned_at, last_replay_at, batches, logs, #{batchLimit}, #{logLimit} FROM suspended RETURNING id ) SELECT count(*)::integer FROM queued

WITH due AS ( SELECT id FROM public.ban_replay_application_suspensions WHERE mail_status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY next_attempt_at, id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ), claimed AS ( UPDATE public.ban_replay_application_suspensions notice SET next_attempt_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '15 minutes', mail_attempts = notice.mail_attempts + 1 FROM due WHERE notice.id = due.id RETURNING notice.* ) SELECT claimed.id, claimed.app_id AS application_id, app.app_id, owner.email, owner.nickname, claimed.suspended_at, claimed.replay_batches, claimed.replay_logs, claimed.batch_limit, claimed.log_limit, claimed.mail_attempts FROM claimed LEFT JOIN public.userapp app ON app.id = claimed.app_id AND app.owner = claimed.owner_id AND app.delete_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN public."user" owner ON owner.id = app.owner
